title: Decent Frame
text: Decent Frame. This frame allows you to hang it either horizontally or vertically. The back of the frame is secured with little metal tabs that have to be bent to remove the backing so you can insert your photo. I've had other frames with similar tabs and if you bend them too many times, they sometimes break off. That's okay as long as you still have enough others to hold the back in place. The frame is light weight. One of the four corners isn't glued all together completely, leaving a slight gap. Another of the corners has a spot where the paint is worn away or something. From a distance, it's not too noticeable.  Overall, it's a decent frame. I would compare them to the high end discount store ones, if that makes sense! The discount stores often have super cheap frames and then other frames that are more expensive. Their more expensive ones are not as nice as what you might find at a department store or other higher end store.
